title: How smoothing the affinity matrix affects neighborhood preservation in t-SNE
abstract: arXiv:2608.17190v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dimensionality reduction methods are instrumental to visualize high-dimensional data, and t-SNE stands as one of the most widely used methods due to its emphasis on local neighborhood preservation. A central component of t-SNE is the affinity matrix, which expresses pairwise similarities in the form of symmetrized probabilities, over which the optimization problem of t-SNE is defined. We study how the sharpness of this probability distribution affects neighborhood preservation at different scales. We introduce a row-wise power transform controlled by a parameter gamma that can smooth or sharpen each row of the affinity matrix while preserving sparsity and rank order. We show that this transform is equivalent to rescaling the Gaussian bandwidth and thus to changing the perplexity. translated_title: 平滑亲和矩阵如何影响t-SNE中的邻域保持
translated_abstract: 降维方法对于可视化高维数据至关重要，而t-SNE因其强调局部邻域保持而成为最广泛使用的方法之一。t-SNE的核心组成部分是亲和矩阵，它以对称化概率的形式表达成对相似性，t-SNE的优化问题正是基于此定义的。我们研究了这种概率分布的锐度如何在不同尺度上影响邻域保持。我们引入了一种由参数γ控制的行向幂变换，该变换可以平滑或锐化亲和矩阵的每一行，同时保持稀疏性和秩序。我们证明，这种变换等同于重新缩放高斯带宽，从而改变困惑度。然而，由于概率分布的锐度因点而异，固定的γ会导致依赖于点的有效困惑度，使其与传统的困惑度调整有所不同。
tldr: 本文提出了一种通过参数γ控制的亲和矩阵行向幂变换，并证明其等效于调整高斯带宽和困惑度，但能实现点依赖的有效困惑度，从而更精细地控制t-SNE中不同尺度的邻域保持。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a row-wise power transform controlled by parameter γ for the affinity matrix in t-SNE, showing it is equivalent to rescaling Gaussian bandwidth and perplexity, yet enables point-dependent effective perplexities for finer control of neighborhood preservation across scales.
